description: Job Description – Software Engineer Role: Application Security & Vulnerability Management Job Family: Software Engineering Primary Focus: Cybersecurity Remediation Essential Technology: .NET Core / C# Preferred Technologies: Java and Angular Experience: Bangalore Job Type: Full-Time Role Overview We are looking for a Software Engineer with strong hands-on experience in C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core to support cybersecurity vulnerability identification, assessment, prioritization, and remediation across enterprise applications and services. The role will primarily focus on resolving application security vulnerabilities, Dependabot alerts, outdated or vulnerable dependencies, and secure coding issues. The ideal candidate should have a strong software development background combined with practical application security and vulnerability remediation experience. The individual will collaborate with engineering, DevOps, architecture, and cybersecurity teams to strengthen application security, improve vulnerability management processes, and establish repeatable remediation workflows. Key Responsibilities 1. Vulnerability Analysis & Remediation Analyze, investigate, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities identified through Dependabot and other security scanning tools. Identify and resolve security findings across application code, third-party libraries, frameworks, APIs, container images, and supporting components. Assess vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, business exposure, and application criticality. Upgrade vulnerable or unsupported packages, libraries, and frameworks while minimizing compatibility issues and regression risks. Validate remediation through testing, security rescanning, and appropriate evidence documentation. 2. Secure Software Engineering Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise applications and backend services using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core. Implement secure coding practices throughout the software development lifecycle. Identify and remediate common application security vulnerabilities, particularly OWASP Top 10 risks. Participate in code reviews, solution reviews, security discussions, and root cause analysis. Develop automated tests and regression test coverage for security fixes. 3. DevSecOps & Dependency Management Integrate and improve security checks within CI/CD pipelines and source code repository workflows. Monitor application dependency health and ensure timely remediation of critical and high-severity vulnerabilities. Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve automated security scanning, alert routing, reporting, and policy enforcement. Support the establishment of vulnerability remediation SLAs, exception handling, and escalation processes. Improve dependency management practices and reduce recurring security findings. 4. Security Maturity & Process Improvement Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of vulnerability management processes and maturity models. Establish repeatable workflows covering vulnerability intake, triage, ownership, remediation, validation, exception management, and closure. Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen engineering ownership and reduce recurring vulnerabilities. Support the development of security metrics, dashboards, and maturity assessments. Promote secure engineering practices across development teams. 5. Documentation & Security Artifact Generation Create and maintain vulnerability remediation playbooks, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and workflow documentation. Prepare risk assessment templates, remediation plans, validation evidence, exception records, and audit-ready documentation. Document lessons learned, recurring root causes, secure coding guidelines, and reusable remediation approaches. Communicate remediation progress, technical risks, dependencies, and decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Essential Skills & Experience .NET Development Strong hands-on software development experience with C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core. Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs, backend services, and enterprise applications. Ability to troubleshoot complex application, dependency, framework, build, and runtime compatibility issues. Application Security & Vulnerability Management Proven experience identifying, analyzing, and remediating application security vulnerabilities. Hands-on experience with Dependabot or equivalent Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools. Strong understanding of secure coding practices and OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. Knowledge of CVE concepts and CVSS-based vulnerability assessment and prioritization. Experience upgrading vulnerable dependencies and resolving third-party library security findings. DevSecOps & Engineering Practices Experience with Git-based development, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews. Understanding of automated testing, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience integrating or working with security checks in development workflows. Ability to work closely with cybersecurity, DevOps, architecture, and quality engineering teams. Professional Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent technical documentation and communication skills. Ability to prioritize vulnerabilities based on technical and business risks. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Skills Experience developing, maintaining, or remediating Java applications. Experience with Angular applications and front-end dependency management. Familiarity with security tools such as: GitHub Advanced Security SonarQube Snyk Veracode Checkmarx Black Duck Knowledge of container and cloud security, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure environments. Experience defining vulnerability management processes, remediation standards, security metrics, and maturity models. Experience preparing governance, audit, compliance, and operational documentation. Education & Experience Professional experience in software engineering, including development, maintenance, and support of production applications. Practical experience working with cybersecurity, architecture, DevOps, quality engineering, and product teams. Strong ability to combine hands-on software development with application security remediation. Success Measures Reduction in open critical and high-severity vulnerabilities. Improved vulnerability remediation turnaround time. Timely upgrades and maintenance of application dependencies. Reduction in recurring security weaknesses. Consistent production of complete, traceable, and audit-ready remediation evidence. Increased adoption of secure software engineering practices. Measurable improvement in application security and vulnerability management maturity. Core Competencies Secure Software Development | Vulnerability Remediation | Dependency Management | Application Security | Risk-Based Prioritization | Problem Solving | DevSecOps | Process Improvement | Security Documentation | Stakeholder Communication Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,850,000.00 per year Work Location: In person
